Contact Us

Have a question, need information, or want to discuss care options? We're here to help.

Get in Touch

Whether you're a family member, support coordinator, or healthcare professional. We're happy to answer your questions and discuss how we can help.

Phone

1300 004 267

Email

info@gentlecarenursing.com.au

Enquiries

Contact us to discuss your needs, availability and next steps. This enquiry service is not for emergencies. For a medical emergency, call 000.

Service Areas

Contact us to confirm coverage in your area.

Send Us a Message

Tell us about your enquiry using the form below.

Ready to Request Care?

If you already know what you need, submit a referral so we can discuss suitability, availability and next steps.

referral.html:
1. Home
  2. /Request Care

Request Care

If you are a support coordinator, case manager, health professional, family member, or representative, you can make a referral to Gentle Care Nursing Services. We will review the client's needs and discuss the next steps.

Support coordinators and discharge planners can also visit our For Coordinators & Referrers page to see how we work with referrers.

The Journey

How It Works

From enquiry to care.

01

Submit your enquiry

Fill out the form below with your details and care needs.

02

We acknowledge and respond

A member of our team will contact you to discuss your enquiry and next steps.

03

Care is arranged

We conduct an assessment, create a tailored care plan, and arrange for care to begin. You'll always know what happens next.

Submit Your Enquiry

Share your details and care needs using the form below.

Tell us about the care needed.

What Happens Next

Enquiry Review

Our team reviews your enquiry and care needs.

Personal Response

A real person will contact you with supportive guidance, clear next steps, and answers to your questions.

Care Begins

Once a care plan is agreed, we match you with the right carer and start support as soon as possible.

Prefer to Speak With Someone?

Contact us directly by phone or email. We're here to help.
